description: Trader report card for one Base wallet — realized profit in USD, win rate, closed positions, open positions (value now, cost basis, unrealized P&L), top 5 wins and losses, an unpriced_moves count, and a grade (smart / profitable / mixed / losing / not_enough_history) with its rule. 400/free for a contract address; 404/free if the wallet made no swap in the window; 503/free if the chain read is down. Costs $0.02 per call, paid from clink's shop credits (an existing key; new top-ups are paused). A failed or empty call is free.
name: wallet_pnl
